acip: DANG PO NI, KHYOD DE SGRUB KYI RTAGS YANG DAG GANG ZHIG, KHYOD KYI RTAGS KYIS DE SGRUB KYI DNGOS KYI SGRUB BYA'I CHOS SU BZUNG BYA YANG YIN, DGAG PA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN SRID PA DE, KHYOD DE SGRUB KYI MA DMIGS PA'I RTAGS YANG DAG GI MTSAN NYID,
wylie: dang po ni, khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gang zhig, khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi dngos kyi sgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yang yin, dgag pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun srid pa de, khyod de sgrub kyi ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid
english: Here is the first. The definition of a correct reason used to prove the absence of something in any particular proof is as follows: Any reason which is (1) a correct reason for the particular proof; and (2) such that there can exist one thing which is both (a) the explicit version of the thing which is considered the quality to be proven in the particular proof in which it acts as the reason, and also (b) a negative thing.
